original_sentence: In addition, experts assert that starting younger is better because, if you make a habit of exercising when you are young, you are more likely to keep up those patterns later in life.
translation: 此外，专家认为，越早开始越好，因为如果你年轻时养成锻炼习惯，人生后期就更可能延续这些行为模式。

be more likely to 在本句中对应"更有可能"。
keep up patterns 在本句中对应"保持模式"。
